statements.text: The Lost Ferry and Wolves at Hollow Gate are shown as open, apart from and before Herbs for Old Bess, which is shown as done.
Each open quest shows who gave it and what to do next (The Lost Ferry: Search the reeds south of the ford).
The done quest is marked as done in words or a symbol, not only by colour or by being greyed out.
Choosing a quest shows its whole `description`.
With no quests, the screen says there are none yet, instead of empty space or a heading with nothing under it.
